Q00012_SecretMeetingWithVarkaSilenos/313.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: What brings you to this land of the Varka, traveler of Zephyr Winds?

links.text: Hand over Helmut's chest of military supplies.

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-01.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: We Varka have shown our strength and tenacity in countless battles and wars, but know that we can't survive alone. Everyone needs friends. We're looking for friends to help us fight! Will you fight alongside the mighty Varka Silenos?

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-02.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: We're looking for an exceptionally strong fighter! Why don't you come back when you've developed your skills a bit more? (This quest may only be undertaken by a character of level 74 or above.)

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-11.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: I bet you left a bitter taste in the Ketra Orcs' mouths. What have you brought me?

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-10.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Are you still here? If you want to be a friend of the Varka Silenos, you must go to the advance base of the Ketra Orcs and kill them all! Kill their footmen, raiders, scouts, shamans and war hounds . Bring back 100 badges of Ketra grunts , then you will have proven …

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-14.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Did those gutless Ketras cry when you beat them? How many did you kill? Where are the proofs?

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-13.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: What are you still doing here? Get to the battlefield immediately! You've committed to bring 200 badges of Ketra grunts and 100 badges of Ketra officers . Get the officers' badges from Ketra Orc Warriors, lieutenants, mediums, elite soldiers, centurions, seers, legi…

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-17.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Ah, back from your visit with the Ketra Orcs, are you? What was your trophy?

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-16.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: What are you still doing here? Get to the battlefield immediately! Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-20.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Well, look who's back. from meeting with the Ketra Orcs. What did you find?

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-19.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: What are you still doing here? Get to the battlefield immediately! This entitles you to all the privileges the village can offer! From now on, you can purchase new specialty items and travel to distant hunting grounds through our gatekeeper. We…

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-24.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: You're braver than anyone I've ever seen! All the Varka will do their best to help you. You must visit our village and allow us to demonstrate our gratitude! But don't feel like you need to stay if you're unhappy...

links.text: "I'll keep the promise with the Varka!"

Q00615_MagicalPowerOfFirePart1/31378-01..text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: You have been an inspiration to the Varka, my friend! Udan Mardui has recently expressed interest in assigning a mission to you. Are you up to it?

Q00615_MagicalPowerOfFirePart1/31378-03..text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Have you met the guide of dead souls yet? Of course, I'm speaking of Udan Mardui, located in the center of the village. He has all the details regarding your new mission!

Q00012_SecretMeetingWithVarkaSilenos/313.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Was this sent by Helmut of Goddard? I thank you for coming so far to deliver this precious item. Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-03.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: You've got some nerve, coming around here after helping our enemy! Have you no shame?

However, the trust of Varka will be growing as much as you've showed us. If you wish to strengthen our alliance and become our 4th level ally, bring from the Ketra 300 b…

There is one more mission that remains... If you wish to be our level 5 ally -- our highest honor of trust, obtain 400 badges of Ketra grunts, 400 badges of Ketra office…

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-09.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Respected friend of the Varka. I no longer have any duties to give you. There is no one among us who is as courageous and faithful as you. The Varka Silenos of the village will give you their greatest service and benefit. Come to the Varka's village without hesitati…

links.text: Give up the alliance with the Varka Silenos.

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-12.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: We Varka appreciate your help and friendship. Henceforth, you shall be known as a friend of the Varka! Congratulations! Please accept this Mark of Varka's Alliance - 1st level. It will guarantee you proper treatment in the village shops.
Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Friend of the Varka, go destroy our enemies!
Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: We value your trust, friend.

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-15.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Good job! You've earned this Mark of Varka's Alliance - Level 2. It gives you even more benefits and privileges from the village. If you want to use the warehouse, speak with Warehouse Keeper Hagos.

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-18.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Were you successful? Congratulations! Take this Mark of Varka's Alliance - Level 3. This will give you even more benefits and privileges in the village. New specialty items are available to you, and you may now receive the blessing of Udan Mardui, guide of dead soul…

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-21.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Congratulations! Please accept this Mark of Varka's Alliance - Level 4. It will give you even more benefits and privileges in the village. Now you can travel to other villages through Gate Keeper Teranu Mardui. Now all that remains is for you to become our closest f…

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-25.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Friend of Varka. I, Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk, must warn you, friend of Varka! Once you end our alliance, we will become as strangers... as if we never met! Earning our friendship again will mean starting over at the beginning. Are you sure you want to quit?

Q00611_AllianceWithVarkaSilenos/31378-26.text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Oh well, I suppose I was wrong about you! Good-bye, stranger!

Q00615_MagicalPowerOfFirePart1/31378-02..text: Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk: Very well! Udan Mardui can tell you all about it. You can find him in the center of the village. Get going!
